notes: First HU run 2026-11-02. 24 h (explicit on own page): Budapesti Állatkórház (Lehel u.), Dr. Juhász Tamás Non-Stop Állatkórház, Supervet (all Budapest), Alpha-Vet Székesfehérvár (non-stop claim only in page title/description - verify), Nyíregyházi Oktató Állatkórház ('a nap huszonnégy órájában'). Not 24 h despite third-party claims: ÁTE Kisállatklinika (no night admissions since 1 Mar 2024), Csipet-Csapat (08-22), Budatétényi Állatkórház ('continuous operation' but no explicit 24 h). Duty rotas: Debrecen (until midnight), Szeged (until 22:00), Miskolc (evenings/weekends), Pécs/Baranya (MÁOK county org), Szolnok (weekends). Hungary has no national or county-wide organised small-animal duty; MÁOK duty files are 2023-2024 only. Poison line: no animal poison information line found in Hungary; ETTSZ (+36 80 201 199, 0-24) serves human poisonings only, so no poison_line entry. Unreachable/blocked: new.univet.hu (robots), turiallatkorhaz.hu (robots; Túri Állatkórház kept from MÁOK data, 24 h unverified), fendrikallatorvos.hu (robots), allatorvosiugyeletkecskemet.hu (server error twice - Kecskemét's city-backed duty restarted 2026 per local press but not verifiable; baon.hu/hiros.hu articles client errors), kisalfold.hu Győr duty articles (client error), baranyaugyelet.hu and supervet.hu main page and allatmento.hu (WebFetch provenance - not surfaced by search), allatdokigyor.hu / kisallatorvosgyor.hu (http-https redirect loop), rexrendelo.hu Budapest-0-24 page (bot check), egeszsegvonal.gov.hu (client error), MÁOK Szabolcs-Szatmár-Bereg register (server error). Still thin: Győr (no clinic or central duty number verified; Győr duty is weekdays 20-22, weekends 08-22 per a Győrújbarát practice page), Sopron, Kecskemét duty, Eger (no phone), Szolnok clinics, Komárom-Esztergom, Békés, Nógrád, Hajdúszoboszló duty, Visegrád (none listed; Vác nearest), Tihany (none listed; Balatonfüred nearest). MÁOK register entries carry no hours and are 2020-2025 snapshots - good candidates for the independent check. Individual vets' names were left out; entries named only after a person were skipped. Main sources: MÁOK county registers (GYMS 2024, Békés/Nógrád/JNSZ 2023, KEM and Heves 2020 - old), city pages (tata.hu), the Győr duty group's own member page, and clinic sites. Győr: duty group (19-22 weekdays, 8-22 weekends, rotating clinic) found; schedule page allatorvosiugyeletgyor.hu/beosztas.php is robots-disallowed so no central phone. Kecskemét: allatorvosiugyeletkecskemet.hu server-errored a 3rd time; duty rota (central phone +36 70 643 2431, not overnight) sourced from the participating clinic page ebklinika.hu/ugyelet.html (independent check), 4 Mar 2026 news article as corroboration. Still thin: no overnight/24 h small-animal service found anywhere in these counties; KEM and Heves registers are 2020; Békés, Gyula and Nógrád mostly register-only (no own sites); Kecskemét clinics beyond Tappancs (Bende, Bundás, Akadémia, Vet426, Dömötör) not verified on own sites; Bács-Kiskun MÁOK register mirrors failed.
